functionalReqs: Browse movies, theatres and shows by city
View the seat map with live availability
Hold seats for a few minutes while paying
Confirm the booking after payment; release on failure or timeout
hints: What happens if two requests read 'seat free' and both write 'booked'?
Hold seats with a TTL (a lock row with expiry in the DB, or Redis SET NX EX) before taking payment.

Use a seat-hold table with a unique constraint or conditional update (`UPDATE ... WHERE status='FREE'`), hold expiry, idempotent payment callbacks, a virtual waiting room for spikes, and cached show listings.
nonFunctionalReqs: No double booking (strong consistency for seats)
problemStatement:
Design a **movie ticket booking** system like BookMyShow: users browse shows in their city, pick seats on a seat map, and pay.

Two users must never book the same seat, even when a blockbuster opens and thousands click at the same second.

scaleHints.users: 10M DAU, spikes of 1M users for a premiere

title: Design BookMyShow (Ticket Booking)
